title: Table
description: A populated audit table — a first-class, auto-persisted, re-openable entity that wraps table population (Q36; decisions/0004-scope-binds-to-table-not-thread.md). When a table is created, the system PINS this spec (columns/grain + scope) and SPAWNS table population; `table_population_id` back-references it. Background population survives navigation because it is a server-side task writing cells to var/state.db. Persisted as one `tables` row in var/state.db (this schema is the row's payload), validated against this schema before every write. The pinned `dataset_id` scope is FIXED for life (decision 0004); immutability is enforced elsewhere (Issue 3) — this contract only stores it.

title.description: Clinician-readable table title (often derived from the originating message).

description.description: Optional longer description of what the table audits.

brief.description: The Brief — the user-intent text the originating Table request recorded, kept on the pinned table for life: the delegation instruction the Table agent works from when populating (and re-populating) the table. Optional: absent means no brief was recorded (a direct create, or a table predating the Brief) — never an empty string.

source_template.description: A seeded audit/template id whose spec.json + mapping back table population (e.g. `cord-ph`, `npda`), OR the literal `"ad-hoc"` for a describe-it table the (template-backed-only) table population cannot yet populate.

dataset_id.description: The PINNED scope — a Dataset id, or null = the whole hospital database. FIXED for life (decision 0004); Issue 3 enforces immutability, this contract only stores it.

scope_disclosure.description: Clinician-readable disclosure of the pinned scope, e.g. "the whole hospital database".

spec.description: The PINNED columns/grain snapshot taken at creation (for a template-backed table, a minimal snapshot derived from the audit's spec.json).

grain.description: The pinned grain, e.g. "one row per patient record".

table_population_id.description: The table population this table owns; null until spawned (and for an `ad-hoc` table the template-backed table-population path cannot yet populate).

status.description: Mirrors the table result status (refreshed from table-population state on read).

reporting_period_label.description: Clinician-readable reporting period — from the Dataset's date filter, falling back to the run/creation date.

thread_id.description: Provenance back-ref to the thread that spawned this table (NOT containment; the table is first-class per Q36). null when created directly.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 (UTC) last-activity time. Drives recency ordering in the Tables list.
